هل قاعدة البيانات هذه كاملة لكل الجامعات: Is this database complete for all universities?
لا، ما زالت قيد التوسّع. هي حاليًا مبنية: No, it is still expanding. It is currently built on data we have actually verified from the universities' own websites, and we keep adding new universities and majors. See the “Universities we are working on adding” section above.
لماذا لا يوجد لبعض البرامج سعر ساعة أو م: Why do some programs have no hourly price or admission average?
لأننا لا ننشر أي رقم مالي أو أكاديمي إلا: Because we do not publish any financial or academic figure until we have confirmed it from an official source. Many universities put fee details and admission requirements in separate PDF files that are hard to extract automatically — in that case we write “Check with the university” instead of guessing a wrong number.
هل توجد بوابة قبول موحدة للماجستير في ال: Is there a unified admission portal for master's programs in Jordan, like the Tawjihi portal?
لا. بوابة القبول الموحد (admhec.gov.jo): No. The Unified Admission portal (admhec.gov.jo) covers only bachelor's and diploma programs. Postgraduate admission (master's and doctorate) is fully decentralized — each university runs its own admission through its Deanship of Graduate Studies.
هل هذه الصفحة رسمية أو بديل عن موقع الجا: Is this page official, or a substitute for the university's website?
لا، هذه أداة دليل مساعدة فقط لتسهيل المق: No, this is only a guide tool to make initial comparison easier. Always rely on the official website of the graduate studies deanship at the university you are considering for final details and exact application dates.
هل الأسعار المعروضة للأردنيين فقط أم لغي: Are the prices shown for Jordanians only or for non-Jordanians too?
السعر الأساسي المعروض في كل بطاقة هو سعر: The main price shown on each card is the credit-hour price for Jordanian students. Some universities (such as Yarmouk and Amman Arab) charge a completely different price for non-Jordanians — sometimes 2-4 times higher, and sometimes in dollars rather than dinars. If this is available and confirmed from the official source itself, it appears right next to the Jordanian price with the label “non-Jordanian”. If no figure appears for non-Jordanians, it means the university does not publish it separately on its website — so contact it directly if you, or someone you know, is not Jordanian.
هل برامج الماجستير عبر الإنترنت معتمدة ف: Are online master's programs accredited in Jordan?
تحققنا من موقع دائرة معادلة الشهادات الر: We checked the official Certificate Equivalence Department website (rce.mohe.gov.jo) and found the exact rule:
\"يشترط لمعادلة الشهادات التي تم الحصول: “For degrees obtained through fully remote e-learning to be equated, they must be in one of the fields of humanities or social knowledge only”
. ومعنى ذلك أن أي تخصص غير إنساني أو اجت: . This means any major that is not humanities or social (engineering, computing, medicine, business, sciences...) has no equivalence at all, regardless of the university — and we put a red warning mark on every card of these majors. Even in the permitted humanities majors, we searched the official ministry tool for well-known universities (Arizona, Purdue) and the result was “no data” — meaning we could not actually confirm the accreditation of any specific university from our list. Check with the Certificate Equivalency Department yourself before enrolling, especially if you will use the degree for a government job.
من أين جاءت أسماء برامج الإنترنت، ولماذا: Where do the online program names come from, and why are there no prices?
أسماء البرامج والجامعات حقيقية ومتأكدون: The program and university names are real and verified — either directly from the university's own website or from a well-known international program directory (distancelearningportal.com). For Arizona State University, Purdue and Southern New Hampshire programs we show the actual per-credit price published on each university's website (in US dollars, approximate depending on the exchange rate). For the remaining programs (from the international directory) we have not yet been able to collect reliable prices, so we write "check with the university" rather than guess a wrong number. The total number of credit hours also varies widely from one program to another, even within the same university (roughly 30-45 hours in most cases), so we only give a single figure when we are sure of it for a specific program.
